:::{#exr-rank-dim-practice}
#### Finding a rank from the column space

@thm-rank-dim reads the [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix)
off the [dimension](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) of its [column space](#def-column-space).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 6}.
$$

Find $\rankf{\matr{A}}$ by finding $\dim\paren{\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

In $\matr{A}$, the second column is a multiple of the first.

:::

:::
